card.name: Words just before brain region names
card.fires_on: Small words, side words or word starts right before a brain region name, in brain imaging text. Examples are 'the' before lentiform nucleus, 'right' before temporal lobe, and 'prec' before uneus.

modes.label: Linking word before a region
modes.description: A small word like the, in or a colon comes just before a named brain structure.
modes.example: FDOPA uptake is bilaterally reduced in<< the>> putamen and in the caudate

modes.label: Side word before a lobe
modes.description: The word right (or a side-word start) comes just before a lobe or sulcus name.
modes.example: A patient with a treated glioblastoma in the<< right>> temporal lobe, showing positive visual uptake

modes.label: Start of precuneus
modes.description: The first piece of precuneus after cingulate and a slash.
modes.example: the posterior cingulate cortex/<<prec>>uneus, and the parietal

card.writes: It suppresses 'elect' and 'ev' word starts and promotes 'front' words, hinting at frontal lobe as the next region.
card.plain: It fires in brain scan text just before a brain region is named, nudging the model toward 'frontal'.
